function.name: agent_browser
function.description: Execute an agent-browser command. Runs against the active session by default. Add --session <name> to target or create a different session, and --engine <engine> to choose a browser engine.

command.description: The command to execute, e.g. 'agent-browser open https://google.com' or 'agent-browser --session new-session open https://example.com' or 'agent-browser snapshot -i' or 'agent-browser click @e3'
